### Raid Report Overview: `a17wMGxvb6QgjBRH`

**Verdict:** A successful raid session across three distinct boss encounters—all ending in **kills** with zero wipes on boss pulls, though the raid group showed clear tank vulnerability on *Kith'ix* and heavy avoidable damage intake in *The Blinding Vale*.

---

### Per-Boss Breakdown

#### 1. Kith'ix (Normal, 14-Player Raid) — **KILL**
* **Fight Duration:** 3m 52s (231.95s)
* **Headline Finding:** Secured the kill, but both tanks died late in the fight—Holysmight collapsed at 02:40, followed by Toastmasterz expiring to Purgatory at 04:47 right before the boss went down.
* **Single Biggest Improvement Opportunity:** **Tank Active Mitigation on Tank-Busters.** Holysmight suffered an unmitigated 593,292 hit (1,051,323 total damage, 70,623 overkill) from *Dark Devastation* without defensive coverage active, causing an early tank loss that overstressed the remaining tank stack.
* **Source:** [Kith'ix — Report a17wMGxvb6QgjBRH (Fight 1)](https://www.warcraftlogs.com/reports/a17wMGxvb6QgjBRH#fight=1)

---

#### 2. The Blinding Vale (Difficulty 10, 5-Player Group) — **KILL**
* **Fight Duration:** 16m 55s (1,014.93s)
* **Headline Finding:** A clean, zero-death marathon kill driven by high DPS throughput from Hipermtropia (142.36M damage) and Dragustar (140.31M damage).
* **Single Biggest Improvement Opportunity:** **Avoidable Ground & Beam Damage Prevention.** The party absorbed massive avoidable damage across the fight—notably 7.21M from *Spouting Floret*, 5.53M from *Oozing Xylem*, and 3.70M from *Lightcrazed Frenzy*—forcing healer Хельмунд to pump 68.10M total healing to maintain stability.
* **Source:** [The Blinding Vale — Report a17wMGxvb6QgjBRH (Fight 3)](https://www.warcraftlogs.com/reports/a17wMGxvb6QgjBRH#fight=3)

---

#### 3. The Undead Trollbunal (Difficulty 108, Solo) — **KILL**
* **Fight Duration:** 40.8s
* **Headline Finding:** Rapid solo burst kill by Subtlety Rogue Ravenhøldt, dealing 15.58M damage with zero deaths and minimal health lost.
* **Single Biggest Improvement Opportunity:** **Opener CD Alignment.** With only 578k melee damage taken, tight opener execution and cooldown pooling will allow total elimination of boss melee swings before phase transitions.
* **Source:** [The Undead Trollbunal — Report a17wMGxvb6QgjBRH (Fight 8)](https://www.warcraftlogs.com/reports/a17wMGxvb6QgjBRH#fight=8)
